_comment: Goldens for the WS-F ACVP-format prototype, portable to non-JS runners. irCanonicalSha256/planCanonicalSha256/responseCanonicalSha256 are SHA-256 over canonical JSON (keys sorted, no whitespace, non-ASCII \uXXXX-escaped == Python json.dumps(o, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'))). The response golden was produced by BOTH the C++ and Rust engines (identical) and matches NIST expectedResults.json for every answered test. Regenerate a full bundle with: npx tsx scripts/acvp-respond.ts --prompt <fixture>/prompt.json --engine cpp --out <dir> --emit-bundle <dir>.
